 UP vs Baroda SMAT 2026 Live Streaming 
 UP vs Baroda SMAT Live Streaming: RCB Stars Bhuvneshwar Kumar & Krunal Pandya Face Each Other
 Aaryan Raj Published -  Nov 18, 2026, 08:12 AM 3 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Krunal Pandya Bhuvneshwar Kumar RCB The Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026-27 season will feature a high-profile Elite Group A match on November 18 as Uttar Pradesh takes on Baroda. The match is scheduled for the MCA Sharad Pawar Cricket Academy in BKC, Mumbai. Star RCB players like Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Krunal Pandya, will face each other in the premier domestic tournament. 
 Both teams are entering the fixture after securing one win and one defeat from their opening two matches. Uttar Pradesh began with a defeat to Rajasthan on November 14, but recovered with a win over Karnataka the next day. Baroda suffered a close-margin defeat against Chandigarh before making a statement chase against Mizoram.
 Karan Sharma is leading the Uttar Pradesh squad that features veteran bowlers such as Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Mohsin Khan and Shivam Mavi . Krunal Pandya, who is considered one of the best all-rounders in India , will captain the Baroda side.
 Both the teams have top-class players, and the fans will be eagerly looking forward to it. Cricket fans in India who are searching for UP vs Baroda SMAT 2026 live streaming platforms will find this article helpful.
 Where to Watch UP vs Baroda SMAT 2026 Match Live?
 Unfortunately, the UP vs Baroda Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy live streaming is unavailable for the viewers and fans. The 2026-27 season of SMAT listed a few key matches to be streamed live on JioHotstar and broadcast on the Star Sports Network. Hence, the fans cannot watch the UP vs Baroda SMAT match live

 Bhuvi vs Pandya: RCB Stars Faceoff
 The match is gaining significant attention, with the scheduled meeting between Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Krunal Pandya , who are both part of RCB's IPL setup. Bhuvneshwar, representing Uttar Pradesh, has already made a mark by taking 2/36 against Karnataka, as UP secured a 16-run victory after posting 204/5.
 Krunal, meanwhile, has contributed with both bat and ball for Baroda, scoring 40 runs and picking up three wickets across his opening two matches. Bhuvneshwar and Krunal were also announced together in India's squad for the 2026 Hong Kong Sixes, with Bhuvneshwar Kumar initially set to lead. 
 However, he then got a call-up for the India-New Zealand tour, making his much-awaited return to the international setup after four years. Krunal Pandya then took over as captain after Bhuvneshwar withdrew from the six-over format. The two RCB teammates now get another chance to share the spotlight, this time as opponents in domestic cricket.
